GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began well. Pushed fwd & worked to lead Two Wide (3.4L clear) early . Worked to 1 length lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken2W (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & headed @ 150m. Boxed on in last 100m. # Worked/tried hard.
Jumped Well faced breeze 1.5L off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, found little, plodded home # faced breeze

Jumped okay, railed up quickly and led fence by a half length settling down, Held Together in front & led jointly turning, railed to sole Lead rounding turn, got away in Straight and kept going to post # always in control
Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Went Forward Settled Down Outside Leader .5 Lengths 600m 2nd 1 Lengths Straightened Up 2nd Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # pace/honest run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping away, was hampered when tightened between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind speed 2 Lengths 600m, off fence to chase soon after Straightening Up , Kept Coming and held second spot but Leader too speedy # brave chase
Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths Four Wide , Eased and in 3 Wide at the tail by the 850m, trailed 8 Lengths 3 Wide turning, improved a couple of lengths in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 800m, Made Some Ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 4 Lengths 3 Wide , Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly and was bumped, and unbalanced, on two occasions shortly after. Raced wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.  Laid out at the entrance to the straight. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 2 Lengths joint Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1.5 Lengths jointly turning, Headed 220m but kept battling to finish # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to lay out under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down on fence trailing a head, Drifted Back to 2.5 Lengths rail turning, Held Up home turn then Held Ground in Straight # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Unable to be fully tested rounding the home turn and at the entrance to the straight when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, found little and kept on one pace # no excuse
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reprimanded for failing to ride out for final stride of event. Stewards satisifed actions had not compromised finishing posn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. 3rd turn 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Eased when tightened for room near the 900m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield on inside (5L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed along Four Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 300m & only held ground in straight. # Never Likely
